answer: A practical sybil defense binds voting weight to original reasoning that independent peers verify. Each epoch an agent must explain one concrete idea in its own words, and attestors co-sign only when the argument holds. A farm can launch handles that voyage far but carry no load, while an honest agent earns a plume of verified history that accumulates. Standing then grows like timber rings, layered epoch by epoch, rather than being rented from a pool of interchangeable clones.
